abilities.name: Bestow Hope
abilities.description: passive 70% of the damage Auriel deals to Heroes and 35% dealt to non-Heroes is stored as energy. Bestow an allied Hero with Hope. While they remain near Auriel, 30% of their damage to Heroes and 10% of their damage to non-Heroes is converted to energy. Auriel can only have Bestow Hope on 1 ally at a time. Auriel can store up to 475 energy.

abilities.name: Sacred Sweep
abilities.description: Sweep the area with sacred power, dealing 40 damage to enemies and an additional 160 damage to enemies caught in the center.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Stationary channel
fields.notes: 1) Target search is done in five 20 degree sections rotating inward from both sides over the duration of the channel. Enemies in the center area take both base and center damage. Center damage is dealt in an additional instance to all targets once the cast finishes.

abilities.name: Ray of Heaven
abilities.description: Consume Auriel's stored energy and heal allied Heroes in the area for the amount of energy consumed.

abilities.name: Detainment Strike
abilities.description: Deal 55 damage to the first enemy Hero hit and knock them back. If they collide with terrain, they are also Stunned for 1.25 seconds and take an additional 165 damage.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Knockback, Skillshot, Stun
fields.notes: Detainment Strike also interacts with pathing blockers, which are usually not considered as real terrain.

abilities.name: Crystal Aegis
abilities.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 damage to all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Resurrect
abilities.description: Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 3 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died. Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability during its cast puts it on a 10 second cooldown.

talents.name: Increasing Clarity
talents.description: quest Every time Sacred Sweep hits a Hero in the center, increase the center damage by 2, up to 50. After hitting 25 Heroes, this center damage bonus is increased to 180.
_raw_fields: quest Every time Sacred Sweep hits a Hero in the center, increase the center damage by 2, up to 50. After hitting 25 Heroes, this center damage bonus is increased to 180.

talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by 3 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by its center.
_raw_fields: Reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by 3 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by its center.

talents.name: Searing Light
talents.description: Ray of Heaven also deals damage to enemy Heroes in the area equal to 30% of the energy consumed.

talents.description: Increases the radius of Sacred Sweep by 15%.

talents.name: Heavy Burden
talents.description: Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Slow and duration are doubled on the enemies it Stuns. passive Increase Detainment Strike's Stun duration by 0.25 seconds.
_raw_fields: Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Slow and duration are doubled on the enemies it Stuns. passive Increase Detainment Strike's Stun duration by 0.25 seconds.

talents.description: Passive Enemies hit by Detainment Strike are knocked back 30% farther. quest Every time Detainment Strike Stuns a Hero, increase the Stun damage by 10, up to 60. After stunning 6 Heroes, increase this damage bonus to 250.

fields.notes: There is no increase in the speed of the knockback.

fields.notes: Self-damage does not grant any energy. The amount of energy stored is calculated after all damage modifiers.

talents.name: Will of Heaven
talents.description: Allies with Bestow Hope gain 20% Attack Speed. passive Auriel gain 10% increased Basic Attack damage.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Auriel's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: Allies with Bestow Hope gain 20% Attack Speed. passive Auriel gain 10% increased Basic Attack damage.

talents.name: Wrath of Heaven
talents.description: Allies with Bestow Hope gain 15% Spell Power. Enemy Heroes hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep or the terrain collision of Detainment Strike have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 3 seconds.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier / Defensive damage modifier
fields.notes: Spell Power from Wrath of Heaven stacks additively with other sources of Spell Power as well as other offensive damage modifiers and healing dealt modifiers affecting the target Hero. Does not stack with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Allies with Bestow Hope gain 15% Spell Power. Enemy Heroes hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep or the terrain collision of Detainment Strike have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Light Speed
talents.description: Resurrected allies gain 200% increased Movement Speed, decaying over 4 seconds. While a resurrected ally remains alive, Resurrect's next cooldown recharges 100% faster.
_raw_fields: Resurrected allies gain 200% increased Movement Speed, decaying over 4 seconds. While a resurrected ally remains alive, Resurrect's next cooldown recharges 100% faster.

talents.name: Diamond Resolve
talents.description: When Crystal Aegis expires, it grants the target 75 Armor for 5 seconds, reducing damage taken by 75%.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.description: cooldown 30 Active After 2 seconds, fly to a target location.

fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability before the cast finishes doesn't put it on cooldown. Auriel is completely untargetable during the flight.
